headline: Brainbees Solutions Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Brainbees Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about acquisition of additional stake in Better & Brighter Homecare Private Limited by Globalbees Brands Private Limited, material subsidiary of the Company.
